name: Palmetto Shirt Company
old_description: Big Cocky Energy – University of South Carolina T-Shirt (Garnet)
about:
Palmetto Shirt Company operates from Leesville, South Carolina, selling officially licensed University of South Carolina Gamecocks apparel through its website palmettoshirtco.com. The business appears under the banner "Koss Creative — Brands for the Whole Family," suggesting a broader brand portfolio. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed on the site.

The company does not manufacture garments but curates and retails a wide assortment of screen-printed t-shirts featuring Gamecocks logos and South Carolina pride motifs. Product lines include the "Palmetto State Collection" with designs such as the Palmetto Tradition Flag, Land of the Free – Home of the Palmetto, and American Born – Carolina Raised, alongside game-day graphics like the Black Magic Skull, Saturday in South Carolina, Watercolor Gamecock, Camo Circle, COCKS 2-Bar, Cocky Overalls, and Camo Helmet tees. Prices range from $19.99 to $28.99. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or equipment are mentioned.

The customer base consists of University of South Carolina alumni, students, and fans seeking licensed merchandise. The company serves the collegiate licensed apparel retail segment. No industrial or B2B customers are indicated.

The site does not state a founding mission or differentiators beyond official licensing and product variety.
